task: Verify Lattice Authority receipt proofs, write production gate_decision receipt refs, and consume them in lifecycle gates when Authority-backed evidence is required.
outcome: A user running lattice authority receipt verify sees Receipt verification: PASS for a valid proof, and a later lattice validate or DONE gate prints Authority gate consumption: PASS strongEvidenceConsumed=true receiptId=<id> only after consuming the verified server receipt.
facts: The CLI already has Ed25519 canonical signing helpers and can verify Python-compatible hex public keys and signatures.
The CLI already has a pure authority-gate-receipts predicate for production-gate-decision refs.
The Server story B-f053 owns the receipt proof bundle endpoint needed for inputDigest and decisionDigest recomputation.
Transport accepted, local diagnostic receipts, and host transcripts must not set receiptVerified, strongEvidenceConsumed, or productionDone.
INIT reviewers recorded two medium advisories: add concrete userSees outputs and separate status/operator feedback from DONE gate policy.
constraints: Default local workflow must not break for stories that do not require Authority-backed evidence.
Enforce mode must fail closed on missing, stale, corrupt, or non-production receipt refs.
Receipt consumption must be idempotent and cannot double-derive strongEvidenceConsumed on retry.
DONE must re-check current head/material and should require a distinct DONE receipt unless policy explicitly allows TEST coverage.
Do not add multi-tenant key management, UI dashboard, or broad revocation service in this slice.
